# Iltonggi (一統記 · 일통기)

> A Three Kingdoms strategy game for iOS by ipe Studio, in 13 languages. This site has the game page, release notes and a making-of blog (one short note a day).

## Pages
- [Home](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/): what the game is
- [Release notes](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/releases/): what changed in each TestFlight build
- [Support](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/support/)
- [Privacy](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/terms/)

## Blog (every post exists in en, ko, ja, zh, es, pt, id, ru, vi, fr, de, ar, hi)
- [Blog index](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/)
- [RSS feed](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/feed.xml)
- [Daegaya, 562: The Year the Last Gaya Closed](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/daegaya-562-last-gaya/): Eight years after Daegaya stood with Baekje at Gwansanseong, this is how the records say it fell to Silla in 562, and what kind of kingdom Gaya is in Iltonggi.
- [The Day After You Take a Town: Designing the Aftermath of Conquest](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/taking-a-town-aftermath/): What happens to population and mood right after you take a town in Iltonggi, and why we made sure that winning the battle is not the end of it.
- [Hanji, Ink and the Seal: Choosing a Face for the Map](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/hanji-ink-seal-screen/): The materials and rules behind three look drafts for Iltonggi's map, redrawing the same land as clay wall, hanji paper and an old surveyor's sheet.
- [Gwansanseong, 554: Where an Alliance Ended](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/gwansanseong-554-alliance-ends/): Three years after the 551 Han River scenario, the Baekje-Silla alliance broke at Gwansanseong. Here is that scene, and where Iltonggi's diplomacy rules touch it.
- [Keeping Direct Command From Becoming a Cheat: Balancing It by Computer](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/direct-command-in-battle/): How we keep Direct Command in Iltonggi from becoming a cheat by balancing it with simulated battles, why its rules stay simple, and what is still left to do.
- [The 551 Han River Contest: Unnamed Generals Become "General ○○"](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/han-river-551-history-check/): Building Iltonggi's 551 Han River scenario: dropping out-of-era generals, placing Kim Mu-ryeok and the Daegaya king, and why unknown names stay "General ○○."
- [Four Kingdoms, Four Colors, Still Distinct at Night](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/four-kingdoms-four-colors/): How we picked colors for Goguryeo, Baekje, Silla and Gaya in Iltonggi, measured whether they stay distinct day and night, and added hanja chips and shapes too.
- [A Three Kingdoms Land Grab for Your Phone](https://iltonggi.ipe.rest/blog/why-a-three-kingdoms-land-grab/): Why we're building Iltonggi, a Three Kingdoms land-grab game for your phone: 5-10 minute rounds, autosave, a short first game, and no daily log-in pressure.
